title: Make and manage power
intro: A beginner's path from electrical safety and basic theory to batteries, solar panels, charge controllers, inverters and generator care, with pointers to small wind and micro-hydro. It is for understanding and looking after a system; wiring into a house is a job for a qualified electrician.

limits.text: Electricity can kill at low voltages — deaths have occurred at about 42 volts; electrical work should be done by a qualified electrician or technician following local rules.
Do not short-circuit batteries, which can cause fire or explosion; battery charging can create explosive gases; use insulated tools.
Low-voltage circuits of 115 volts and below can kill; fatalities from voltages as low as 30 volts have been recorded.
Never work alone on electrical equipment, and work on energized circuits only when absolutely necessary.

Never short battery terminals; keep smoking, sparks and open flames away from charging batteries; wear eye and hand protection. If electrolyte gets in the eyes or on skin, flush with water at least 15 minutes and get medical help.
All storage batteries on charge give off an explosive hydrogen–oxygen mixture; never remove connections with current flowing or allow sparks near a battery.

Inverter terminals can stay dangerously energized even when switched off; disconnect the battery before servicing, and leave internal servicing to qualified personnel (Victron manual, model-specific).
A solar array exposed to light supplies high DC voltage to the charge controller; shut down and isolate both the DC and PV sides before disconnecting cables (Victron manual, model-specific).
Connect the charge controller to the batteries first, then the panels; when removing, disconnect panels first. Reversed polarity can damage components; a skilled installer is advisable.
Connecting a generator to house wiring requires an isolation (transfer) switch installed by a qualified electrician; improper connections can backfeed and electrocute utility workers.
Make sure a generator's engine is off and cool before maintenance, and never use gasoline to clean parts.
